# Repo-owned magic_enum snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [Neargye/magic_enum](https://github.com/Neargye/magic_enum) at commit `d01a4f90a63444e910e66c796b93df25abffcfe0`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 30 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original MIT `LICENSE` and the included Catch2 `test/3rdparty/Catch2/LICENSE` are retained. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The Mac build consumes this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt`; other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
